If the girls brought an amount equal to the number of shells brought by the boys plus four times as many seashells as the boys, how many seashells were brought by each girl?
Caroline is three times older than Ben. Ben is two times older than Chris. If Chris is 10, how old is Caroline?
Parker chews 40 pieces of gum a day. A pack of gum has 150 pieces of chewing gum per pack. How many packs of gum will he need to last him 300 days?

Watson works a 10-hour shift each day, five days a week. He earns $10 per hour and gets a $3000 bonus each week if the company performs well. How much money did Watson make in April if the company performed very well for the whole month?
Indras has 60 letters in her name. Her sister's name has 40 more letters than half of the letters in Indras' name. How many letters are in Indras and her sister's names?

Katy makes coffee using teaspoons of sugar and cups of water in the ratio of 7:13. If she used a total of 1200 teaspoons of sugar and cups of water, calculate the number of teaspoonfuls of sugar she used.

Carlos is planting a lemon orchard. The orchard will cost $9000 to plant. Each year it will grow 700 lemons, which he can sell for $15 each. It costs $300 a year to water and feed the trees. How many years will it take before he starts earning money on the lemon orchard?
There are 93,000 pennies in a cup. What is the total dollar amount in a stack that contains two thirds of the pennies in the cup?

An airport has only 20 planes that fly multiple times a day. Each day, the first plane goes to Greece for three-quarters of its flights, and the remaining flights are split equally between flights to France and flights to Germany. The other 19 planes fly exclusively to Poland, and their combined 4400 trips only amount to half the number of trips the first plane makes throughout each day. How many flights to France does the first plane take in one day?
Marin and his neighbor Nancy each eat 4 apples a day. How many apples do they eat in 100 days?

Pam and Fred went to a carnival. Pam rode the roller coaster 20 times while Fred rode it 40 times. After that, each of them decided to ride the luge 20 times. If each ride cost 60 tickets, how many tickets did they use that day?

Thomas withdraws $10000 in 20 dollar bills from the bank account.  He loses 100 bills while getting home.  After that, he uses half of the remaining bills to pay for a bill.  Thomas then triples his money.  He then converts all his bills to 10 dollar bills.  How many 5 dollar bills does he have?

To make a profit of $200,000, Isaias has to sell the chickens he planned to take to the market from his farm at $500 per chicken. If Isaias has 30,000 chickens on his farm and plans to sell 3/5 of them, for how much money did Isaias buy the chicken he took to the market for sale?

Sue lives in a fun neighborhood.  One weekend, the neighbors decided to play a prank on Sue.  On Friday morning, the neighbors placed 180 pink plastic flamingos out on Sue's front yard.  On Saturday morning, the neighbors took back one third of the flamingos, painted them white, and put these newly painted white flamingos back out on Sue's front yard.  Then, on Sunday morning, they added another 180 pink plastic flamingos to the collection. At noon on Sunday, how many more pink plastic flamingos were out than white plastic flamingos?

A water tank is filled with 1200 liters of water. Celine used 900 liters of water from the reservoir to irrigate her small garden. She was then able to collect rainwater that is twice as much as what was left. How many liters of water are in the reservoir now?
To make a call from a payphone, you must pay $0.25 for each minute of your call. After 100 minutes, that price drops to $0.2 per minute. How much would a 120-minute call cost?

John hires a driving service to get him to work each day.  His work is 30 miles away and he has to go there and back each day.  He goes to work 5 days a week for 50 weeks a year.  He gets charged $20 per mile driven and he also gives his driver a $1000 bonus per month.  How much does he pay a year for driving?
An electronics seller bought 50 phones for $7000 each and gives the seller $400,000 in dollar bills. How much will the seller give back in change?
Frankie and Binkie went bowling together. Frankie's score was 150 better more than twice as high as Binkie's. If Binkie bowled a score of 900, what was Frankie's score?
Sally received the following scores on her math quizzes: 500, 800, 800, 600, 400, 900, 1000, 700, and 600. Find her mean score.
After transferring to a new school, Amy made 20 more friends than Lily. If Lily made 100 friends, how many friends do Lily and Amy have together?
A farm has 100 2-legged animals and 150 4-legged animals. If all animals are healthy, how many pairs of animal legs in total are on the farm?

Julie operates the cash register exactly twice as fast as her less-experienced colleague Jewel. In a day, Jewel processes 5000 customers. What is the total weekly production for the two if they work all seven days of the week?

Ali is a dean of a private school where he teaches one class. John is also a dean of a public school. John has 12 classes in his school. Each class has 1/8 the capacity of Ali’s class which has the capacity of 120 students. What is the combined capacity of both schools?

Meredith is a freelance blogger who writes about health topics and submits to clients each day as her permanent job. A blog article takes an average of 240 minutes to research and write about. Last week, she wrote 5 articles on Monday and  2/5 times more articles on Tuesday than on Monday. On Wednesday, she wrote twice the number of articles she wrote on Tuesday. Calculate the total number of hours she spent writing articles in the three days.

Mara added 30 slices of cake to a plate that already had 20 slices on it. She was getting hungrier so she tripled the number of slices she currently has. She ate 25 slices and while she was distracted, her friend stole 55 slices off her plate. What number of cake slices remained on the plate?
Misha picks 40 blouses from the 30% off rack. The regular price for each blouse is $200. How much is the total cost of the discounted blouses?

A teacher uses a 12-centimeter piece of chalk to write math equations on a chalkboard for his students. The teacher likes to conserve chalk, so he tries to only use 20% of the chalk each day. Since the teacher cannot write with a very small piece of chalk, he recycles the chalk when it is smaller than 5 centimeters. On Monday the teacher used a new piece of chalk. His students need extra help that day, so he ended up writing more than usual. He used up 45% of the chalk by the end of the day. If the teacher goes back to using only 20% of the chalk each day, how many days does he have before he has to recycle this piece?

Grandma walks 30 miles every day on her favorite walking trail, which includes 20 miles of walking on the beach and 10 miles of walking on the sidewalk. On the sidewalk, Grandma walks at twice the rate of speed that she does on the beach. If 400 minutes of her walk is spent on the beach, how long does it take for her to complete the entire 30-mile walk, in minutes?

Dale is selling butterscotch candies to raise money for his club at school. He doesn't have the candies yet and is instead just taking orders. He started off with 1000 total that he ordered and wanted to sell, but he ended up selling 1500 butterscotch candies. Then he ordered 1000 more. How many does Dale still need to sell to sell all of his candy?

Rita hand-picks Junebugs off of her plants every summer. On Monday, she removed 390 Junebugs. On both Tuesday and Wednesday, she removed twice as many Junebugs as she did on Monday. Thursday she removed 480 and on Friday she removed 570. What is the average number of Junebugs that she removes per day?
There are 9 Fast and the Furious movies, Deepa has seen each one in the theatre thirty times. She has spent $2160 seeing these movies. What is the average price she paid per ticket?

Shawnda decides that her neighborhood kids could really use a bike inflation service. She decides the best way to charge is by the tire. Each tire costs 250 cents to inflate. On the first day, 50 people on bicycles came by to get both tires inflated. 30 people came by to get all their tricycle tires inflated. Finally, ten people actually came by on a unicycle. How many dollars did she make that day?
Two girls each got 1/6 of the 240 liters of water. Then a boy got 60 liters of water. How many liters of water were left?

Aleena subscribed to a streaming service that charges her $1400 per month. If the streaming company charged her the initial amount for the first half of the year and then charged her 10% less money on the other half of the year, calculate the total amount she had paid for the streaming service by the end of the year.

Beatrice bought ten packets of crayons for her Art class. Six of the packets had ten pieces of colors each, and the other four packets had sixteen pieces of colors each. How many colors of crayons did Beatrice buy in all?

Two sports coaches went shopping together. The baseball coach bought 90 new baseballs for $30 each. The basketball coach bought 80 new basketballs for $140 each. How much more did the basketball coach spend than the baseball coach?

Colby works for a large-scale manufacturing company in the packaging division. He gets paid $0.2000 for every package he completes. If he completes 1000 less than 5000 packages per hour, how much money, in dollars, does he earn in a typical eight-hour workday?
John arm wrestles 2000 people. He beats 80%. How many people did he lose to?

Darren decides to engage in a rigorous body exercise routine for a whole week. He does 1000 pushups, 500 squats, and 200 dumbbell presses. What's the total count of the activities he's done in the two days?
Luke ate 20 hot dogs. Thomas ate three times more hot dogs than Luke. John ate half the amount Thomas ate. How many more hot dogs did John eat than Luke?
15 of the women at the cocktail party are wearing 4-inch heels and 10 are wearing 2-inch heels. What is the average height of heels at this party?
James hires a horse-drawn carriage from 5 PM to 9 PM.  He gets 1 hour free.  The first paid hour is $100 and each hour after that is twice the cost.  How much did he pay?

Colby loves going to the movies and every month his parents give him $1000 to spend at the movies. Tickets for Fridays and Saturdays cost $10. Tickets for any other day cost $7. Popcorn costs $8 and boxes of candy cost $2. It is the last day of the month and it's a Friday. He wants to make sure he gets a popcorn and box of candy that night. How many movies can he see if he already saw 5 movies on a Friday or Saturday, 12 movies on other days, had 10 tubs of popcorn, and 12 boxes of candy that month?

Ram uses a significant number of pens. He discovered that he can save money by mixing the ink from fifty empty pens to make one full pen. If he buys 2500 pens and then uses them to make new pens when the ink runs low, how many total pens does he get to have?
Brandon's iPhone is four times as old as Ben's iPhone. Ben's iPhone is two times older than Suzy's iPhone. If Suzy’s iPhone is one-fifth of 15 years old, how old is Brandon’s iPhone?

A treasure hunter found a buried treasure chest filled with gems. There were 1200 diamonds, 200 fewer rubies than diamonds, and twice the number of emeralds than the rubies.   How many of the gems were there in the chest?
A herd consists of camels and dromedaries. There are 1800 heads and 3040 humps. How many dromedaries are there if camels have two humps each and dromedaries have one hump each?

Sarah has a rope that is 2000 meters long. Her friend wants to buy the rope for $20 a meter. Sarah plans to use the profit to buy a new rope, which at the store costs $15 a meter. How much money will she have left over after she buys the new rope?

Rozanne is making eggnog for her family. She uses 10 dozen eggs that were in cases and another 20 eggs that were loose in the cupboard. She puts out trays that each hold 14 glasses of eggnog. If each glass needs 5 eggs, how many trays can Rozanne put out?
A cobra, which has 7000 spots, has twice as many spots as a mamba. If there are 400 cobras and 600 mambas in a snake park, what is half the number of spots they all have combined?

John decides to build a program capable of identifying cancer cells. He gets initial funding of $1,000,000 for the first 50 months of research. His research ends up taking 10 times that long and every month after those first 50 took 50% more funding per month. How much did his research cost?
Jill gets paid $200 per hour to teach and $300 to be a cheerleading coach. If she works 50 weeks a year, 35 hours a week as a teacher and 15 hours a week as a coach, what's her annual salary?
It takes Matthew 30 minutes to dig a small hole for shrubs and 100 minutes to dig a large hole for trees. How many hours will it take him to dig 300 small holes and 150 large holes?

If he had a 100k a year job before college and his college degree tripled his income, how long would it take to earn the money equivalent to the loans and the money lost from not working while in school.

Adam wants to eat some sliced apples. A large apple can be sliced into 5 pieces, and a small apple can be sliced into 3 pieces. Adam decides to slice 12 large and 15 small apples and then eats 15 slices. How many apple slices are left?

Juan wants to add croissants to his bakery menu.  It takes 1/4 pound of butter to make 1 dozen croissants.  He wants to start with making 10 dozen a day for a week.  How many pounds of butter will he need to make these croissants?
The Ben and Aggie Burrito Shop makes 1250 chimichangas on Tuesdays, 1250 chimichangas on Wednesdays and twice as many on Friday. How many chimichangas do they make on those three days?

Sandy wants to lose as much weight as Joey does but needs 4 weeks to lose the same amount of weight that Joey loses in a single week. If Joey loses 12 pounds in 4 weeks, how many weeks will it take Sandy to lose the same amount of weight?
Ingrid drinks 8 cups of water every day.  If there are 16 cups in a gallon, how many gallons of water does she drink in 300 days?

In Tate’s garden pond, there are 40 male guppies, 70 female guppies, 30 male goldfishes, and 50 female goldfishes. He buys 20 male guppies, 10 female guppy, 20 male goldfishes, and 30 female goldfishes. How many more female fishes than male fishes does Tate have?

Gunter is trying to count the jelly beans in a large jar. He asks his friends how many they think are in the jar. One says 800. Another says 200 more than half the first one. A third says 25% more than the first one. What is their average guess?

Melanie's father opens up an animal farm starting with 5000 cows and 2000 chickens. Milkie Cows Limited brings him 2000 cows per day and Broilers Limited brings him 1000 chickens per day, for three weeks. What's the total number of animals on the farm after three weeks?

Royce takes 400 minutes more than double the time Rob takes to shingle a house. If Rob takes 20 hours, how many minutes does Royce take?

Imma has 10 cats. She feeds her cats twice a day with 125 grams of cat food. How many days will 10000 grams of cat food last?

Apple High School is holding graduation in their Fine Arts Center this year which has space for 60,000 people. After accounting for 9,500 seats for graduates and 3,000 seats for faculty attending, how many tickets would each graduate receive to give to their friends and family if the tickets are split equally?

How much money did the tooth fairy leave Sharon, in dollars?
Carmen has $1000, Samantha has $250 more than Carmen, and Daisy has $500 more than Samantha. How much do all three girls have combined?

Mrs. Sherman made a dozen bread rolls for breakfast. After feeding her 6 children with one each, she broke each of the remaining rolls into 10 pieces and fed them to the chickens. How many pieces of rolls did she feed to the chickens?

She is thinking of walking twice a day, covering 200,000 meters each time. How many more meters per day must Soledad hike to complete her journey on time?

Eliza's rate per hour for the first 40 hours she works each week is $100. She also receives an overtime pay of 1.2 times her regular hourly rate. If Eliza worked for 45 hours this week, how much are her earnings for this week?

Denise and Daniel are reading the same book. Yesterday, Denise read 100 pages while Daniel read 130 pages. Today, Denise read 50 more than as many pages as what Daniel read yesterday, while Daniel was not able to read any pages today. How many more pages did Denise read more than Daniel?

If Martin eats Cheerios every day for breakfast, he'll lose 12.5 pounds over a period of 10 weeks. If he eats donuts every day for breakfast, he'll gain 17.5 pounds over the same period. What will be the difference in his weight at the end of these 10 weeks between the two breakfast options?

Ted the T-Rex was planning to bring potato salad to the dinosaur picnic. He knows that an adult dinosaur will eat 100 lbs of potato salad, and a child will eat half as much as an adult. If there will be 200 adults and 50 children at the picnic, how many pounds of potato salad does Ted need to bring to the picnic if he hopes to have enough to feed everyone?

Terry sells 60 milkshakes for $5.50 each, 90 burger platters for $11 each, and 200 sodas for $1.50 each. How much money does he make in total?

One meatball sub sandwich contains 12 meatballs.  Sidney ordered 3 less than ten meatball sub sandwiches. Then Mark ate 4 of Sidney's meatball sub sandwiches. So Sidney ordered another three sub sandwiches.  How many meatballs were in the sub sandwiches that remained?

In total, how many quarts of strawberries can Tony, Bobby, Ricky, and Kathy pick per hour on Grandma Concetta's farm?

Janet gets a job as a waitress.  She makes $110 an hour from wages and another $15 an hour from tips.  She wants to save up 20% of the cost of a $100000 car for a downpayment.  If she works 40 hours a week how many weeks will she need to work to save the down payment?
Lloyd earns $100 an hour on Math tutoring. He tutored 50 hours for the first week and 80 hours for the second week. How much did he earn for the first two weeks?
Katina has $300,000 in her savings account. If she removes $1,000 from the account every month, how much money will be remaining within the account after 20 years?
Timothy has three times the number of pens that George owns. Sarah has half as many pens as Timothy. If George has 1800 pens, how many pens does Sarah have?

John and DeSean bought a bag of marshmallows to make s'mores together. The bag has 350 marshmallows. Each S'more uses one marshmallow. If John makes 90 S'mores, DeSean makes 90 S'mores, and they dropped 30 marshmallows on the ground, how many S'mores can each kid have with the marshmallows left in the bag?

Mike needed a new pair of jeans.  When he got to the mall he saw that his favorite jeans were advertised 25% off.  The original price of the jeans was $120.  How much money will Mike have left over if he pays with a $150.00 bill?
A plague infects one hundred people. Every day, each infected person infects sixty others. How many people are infected after three days?

Kayla is having her birthday party at a movie theater. The fee to rent the theater is $125 for a party of 20, plus $6 for each additional guest. Kayla invited her 125 classmates and the 7 girls in her dance class, as well as 13 family members. Only 40 people said they could not come. How much will the party cost?

Peyton scheduled after-work activities of a 120 minutes yoga class on Monday, a cooking class that lasts twice as long as Monday’s yoga on Tuesday, a 60 minutes cheese-tasting event on Wednesday, a museum tour that takes the same amount of time as the cooking class on Thursday, and 180 minutes of errands on Friday. How many hours will all Peyton’s after-work activities take?

A company wanted to buy 5000 computers and had $7000 for each computer. However, when they went to order, they realized the price of each computer was 10% higher than they had planned for. Calculate the total amount of money they paid to buy the computers at the new prices.
Mary has 300 sheep. She gets 1000 g of milk from half of them and 2000 g of milk from the other half every day. How much milk does she collect every day?
Leah just got a new kitten. Spaying her cost $2000, her 30 vaccines costs $200 each, and the kitten broke 40 vases that cost $120 each. How much has the kitten cost so far?

Greta wanted brownies for her birthday. She made a batch for herself; one hundred and twenty cream cheese swirl brownies. At her office, they threw her a party and sent her home with 50 brownies. When she arrived home, her friends were there to throw her a surprise party and had 480 brownies waiting. During the party, 150 brownies were eaten. How many individual brownies did Greta have left over from the entire day?
Gary likes to walk around the edge of the local park, which is a rectangle that measures 15 miles by 18 miles. If he walks at 3 miles/hour, how many hours does he spend walking?
Mario needs to buy snowshoes for his 60 sled dogs. Assuming his dogs each has four legs and each pair of snowshoes costs $120, how much will it cost him to buy snowshoes for all of his dogs?

Cynthia eats indulging in three servings of ice cream every night. She purchases cartons of ice cream, each containing 150 servings of ice cream, at a cost of $40 per carton. After 600 days, how much will she have spent on ice cream?

Tobias, Chikote, and Igneous are the three little wolves who live in the forest and howl at the moon every night. When Tobias howls, each howl lasts for a total of 200 seconds. Chikote howls for twice as long as Tobias. And Igneous howls for as long as the other two wolves combined. What is the combined length of time, in minutes, of the three wolves' howls?
1500 gallons of gas were equally divided into 500 different containers. Josey needed 1/4 of a container to run her lawnmower. How many pints of gasoline did Josey need?

A company pays each of its employees $6000 in a month. The company has a policy of increasing the salaries of each of its employees by 10% of the initial salary every year for those who've stayed in the company for five years. If Sylvie just clocked 5 years in the company last December, what's her annual salary after three more years of service?
Christina is planning a birthday party and needs 0.75 gift bags per invited guest, because 1/4 of attendees don't show up. She invited 1600 friends. Gift bags are $2 each. How much will she spend?
Farmer Brown has 200 animals on his farm, all either chickens or cows. They have a total of 700 legs, all together. How many of the animals are chickens?
A builder works for 40 weeks every year and for 6 days every week. If he gets paid $500 every day, how much does he earn if he works for a year?

The rainstorm flooded the wetlands and washed Phineas Frog 7200 inches away from his home in the swamp.  To return home, he will need to hop and swim his way back.  If he hops on land at a speed of 720 inches per minute, and swims through water at a speed of 360 inches per minute, how long will it take Phineas, in minutes, to return home if half of the distance is on land and the other half is in water?

Generally, a 5-year-old avocado tree produces 100 fruits, a 6-year-old one produces 3 times the initial amount of fruits, a 7-year-old one produces 7 times the initial amount, and an 8-year-old produces 200 fruits less than a 10-year-old one. During the ninth year, the avocado tree doesn't produce any fruit, and then a 10-year-old tree produces 20 times the initial amount of fruits. How many total fruits can an avocado tree produce during its 10 years of life?

Mike was a pen pal with 5 people. He stopped being pen pals with 2 of them. They each send 2 letters a week that are 50 pages long. He responds in kind. He can write a page every 6 minutes. How many hours does he spend writing a week?

A phone tree is used to contact families and relatives of Ali's deceased coworker. Ali decided to call 30 families. Then each family calls 30 other families, and so on. How many families will be notified during the fourth round of calls?

Rayna has 6000 more dollars than Kassidy, and Kassidy has 3/4 times as much money as Aurelia. If Aurelia has $12000, how much would each have if they decided to add together their money and share equally among them?

A car in the fast lane is traveling at 100 miles/hour. A car in the slow lane is traveling at half that speed. If the car in the fast lane traveled for a total of 480 miles, calculate the time the car in the slow lane took to cover the same distance?

Ralph has a record store where people can trade their own records for new ones. People can trade 2 old records for 1 new one. 15 people come in with old records and leave with 12 new records between them. How many old records did the 15 people bring in?

Betsy and Donovan spent a day cooking together. Betsy's part took 1800 minutes longer than Donovan's part. The entire cooking process was completed in 9800 minutes. How many minutes long was Betsy's part?

Abraham owns 8000 square meters of unused land. He sold half of the land for $5000, and after a month, he sold another 1/4 of his land for $3000. He then sold the remaining land for $3 per square meter. How much money will he be able to earn after selling all his unused land?

The great pyramids sit at an angle of 32 degrees from the ground when you stand at the entrance of Sahir's house. The sun is moving at 12 degrees an hour straight upward from the pyramid relative to Sahir's house. If the sun starts at the tip of the pyramid and moves for 10 hours, how many degrees will there be from the ground to the sun?
Zeke's baseball team has 70 more players than Carlton's. If Carlton's team has 130 players, how many players are there in both teams combined?
Anthony had 5000 pencils. He gave 1/2 of his pencils to Brandon, and he gave 3/5 of the remaining pencils to Charlie. He kept the remaining pencils. How many pencils did Anthony keep?

Helena is a mad scientist testing her latest creation, the Lots-of-Limbs Serum. The serum will make the drinker grow an extra arm every thirty days and an extra leg every fifty days. After one thousand five hundred days, how many new limbs will Helena’s serum cause a person to grow if they drink it?
Peter plans to go to the movies this week. He always gets a ticket for $7 and popcorn for $7. If he has 420 dollars for the week, how many times can he go to the movies?

John invited 20 people to a birthday party.  Each guest will eat 2 hot dogs.  He already has 10 hot dogs left over from a previous party.  If a pack of hot dogs contains 10 hot dogs and costs $2, how much does he need to spend on hot dogs?

Mark took a test yesterday that consisted of 175 questions. He completed the test at a rate of 10 questions per hour. Today, he took another test of 100 questions at the same rate. If Mark had 10 hours to complete the first test and 6 hours to complete the second one, how many questions did he leave incomplete?

Caroline has 4 children.  The first child is 72 inches tall.  The second child is two inches taller than the first child.  The third child is 10 inches shorter than the second child.  And the fourth child is three inches taller than the third child.  How tall is the fourth child, in inches?
